LESSON: MANAGING RESOURCES:

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachaar (Social Ethics)
Topic 5.1: Managing Resources:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Managing Resources:
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we take care of resources in school and community?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. classify the types of resources relevant in their life for harmonious living
2. explain correct uses of various resources for better living
3. demonstrate appropriate use of resources for sustainable development
4. describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation
5. practise Pranayam and Asanas for physical wellbeing
